cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Credit for the Discovery
cards.instruction: Make someone acknowledge that you found the clue, saw through the deception, or designed the successful scheme.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Before calling it our discovery, mention who found the receipt. Please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Yes. After my receipt introduced it properly.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll put your name in the report.
